reason: Initial artifact audit found pooled deployment checkpoints but no restorable dense full-provider holdout predictions. The parent-authorized plan is to reconstruct the current dense controls on the declared provider-held-out cohort, then apply the already frozen inference transform.

scope_change.control: Reconstructed matched current dense control fits for the three full-provider folds, both seeds, clean/feed_like views, using the existing dense package architecture, recipe, source exclusions and matching inputs. These controls are explicitly labeled reconstructed; they are not claimed as byte-identical original holdout checkpoints.
scope_change.candidate: No new model fits. Apply the unchanged fixed inference-time memory transform to each reconstructed control's saved native probabilities, then form the equal-probability ensemble.
scope_change.fitting_owner: dense_label_weight_v1 coordinated by the parent task agent
scope_change.required_before_candidate_scoring: Reconstructed control replay/parity audit and source/input/checkpoint receipts must pass. If parity cannot be established, stop and report the blocker.

input_contract.period_semantics: NPZ period is the original input period for official scoring; memory/decoder block IDs are independently derived by supervised.model_periods(inputs).
input_contract.scoring: Run full control replay first across 15 match/view/replicate cells, with 45 seed/ensemble member rows; only then apply the fixed candidate transform and score candidates.

readout_screen.primary: Equal-provider clean spell-F1 gain >= +0.01 for the ensemble.
readout_screen.provider_guards: For every held-out provider and each seed/ensemble member, clean macro-F1 and D-F1 deltas >= -0.02.
readout_screen.role: Descriptive fixed screen for interpreting this experiment only; no promotion or adoption is authorized.
